releases.name: Transport Fever 3
releases.summary: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

releases.name: Gothic II Complete Classic
releases.summary:
Continue the story of the Nameless Hero in Gothic II Complete Classic, the award-winning sequel that improved on its predecessor in every way. Experience it now for the first time on Nintendo Switch.

Gothic II Complete Classic brings together the excitement of Gothic II and the add-on Night of the Raven to your fingertips for the first time on a console.

You have torn down the magical barrier and released the prisoners of the Mine Valley. Now the former criminals of the forests and mountains are causing trouble around the capital of Khorinis. The town militia is powerless due to their low amount of force - outside of the town, everyone is helpless against the attacks of the bandits.

releases.name: Way of the Hunter 2
releases.summary: Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the Canadian wilderness.

releases.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered
releases.summary:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes the generation-defining RPG with a range of upgrades and enhancements to visuals, performance, gameplay, and more. Become monster slayer for hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across the war-torn Northern Kingdoms to find your adopted daughter, Ciri, before the spectral forces of the Wild Hunt take her incredible power for their own. Included in Remastered are two critically acclaimed expansions — Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine — to expand the legendary story even further.

Explore a Dark Fantasy World — Journey through the war-torn Northern Kingdoms and explore richly detailed regions, from bustling cities to forgotten ancient ruins and superstitious villages.

Experience an Unforgettable Story — Traverse the Continent in search of Geralt’s adopted daughter Ciri, the Child of Prophecy, who is being ruthlessly hunted by the spectral Wild Hunt.

Master a Witcher’s Arsenal — Embody the White Wolf and show your foes what it means to be a witcher with a variety of swords, potions, bombs, combat magic, and more.

Modernized and Upgraded — Refined with an upgraded skill system, revamped combat, improved visuals, and more, Remastered is the definitive way to enjoy this acclaimed RPG.

releases.name: TOEM 2
releases.summary:
Ready your camera and set off on a new photo adventure in TOEM 2!

Tie those sneakers and ready your camera, it’s time to set off on a new photo adventure in TOEM 2! Head off on a relaxing journey, spurred on by your newly-awakened passion for discovering and photographing mysterious “events” known as TOEMs. TOEM 2 was crafted to be welcoming for both returning fans of TOEM and those who want to jump in for the first time.

Explore: Run, jump, and climb your way through all-new cozy environments, uncovering hidden paths, scenic viewpoints, and small details waiting to be discovered. The world is built to reward curiosity, so take your time and wander wherever your camera leads you.

Meet: Encounter a cast of new quirky characters and adorable critters along your journey. Lend a hand to new faces, create lasting friendships, and catalogue your memories as you go along.

Snap: Your camera has gotten an upgrade! Not only can you snap pictures to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and document your discoveries, you can also use them in more unconventional ways, with new attachments letting you overcome various problems in each region.

Stamp: Fill your journal with stamps as you complete quests, document discoveries, and expand your critter compendium. Each stamp is not only a reminder of the little wonders you’ve uncovered along the way — they’re also your ticket to unlocking the next region.

Set Your Pace: TOEM 2 is built to be experienced at your own pace with no time limits or tricky requirements for full completion. Listen to music on a bench, smell the flowers, admire the sights and enjoy.

releases.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
releases.summary:
A hero’s work is never done! Disorder is brewing, and the world stands before a threat unlike any other. A new danger is growing in power, ready to descend upon the land and unleash mayhem.

Return to the world of Minecraft Dungeons in an all‑new action RPG adventure, brimming with high‑stakes encounters, thrilling challenges, and never‑before‑seen locations, as you set out to save a world in crisis. Will you and your allies prevail against the forces of evil and save the day once more?

releases.name: Blades & Battles
releases.summary:
Blades & Battles is a fantasy Beat'Em Up game that takes players to the heart of the legendary world of King Arthur in his barbarian youth. A modern version of classic titles such as Golden Axe.

The game features 2 playable characters: Arthur and Lancelot, with their own skill sets and sword fighting styles.

Filled with beautiful scenery and cinematic interactive moments, it's an immersive, action-packed experience of chivalry, honor and adventure.

releases.name: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
releases.summary: Take the fight to your pesky neighbors in a mayhem filled team-based online co-op battle. Assemble a team of iconic residents, attack your rival’s home with crazy items, and deploy devious traps to defend your own. Whose house will survive to rule the neighborhood?

releases.name: Keep Driving
releases.summary:
Keep Driving is a management RPG about slowly making your way through a procedurally generated pixel art open world. Pick up hitchhikers with their own personalities and stories; upgrade, customize and repair your car. Solve challenges on the road using a unique turn-based ‘combat’ system, using your own skills and whatever’s lying around in the glovebox to make it through.

At the end of your road trip, return back to the beginning and see what happens if you had followed a different path. There are multiple endings, with each taking about 1-4 hours to complete. 

Immerse yourself in the land through its highways, dirt tracks, and calm country roads. And remember to enjoy the ride. You're young and don't have much to lose.

releases.name: A Love Letter in Snowfall
releases.summary: is a live-action, multi-ending interactive romance movie game. As a young B&B keeper in a small southern town, you meet, and fall for a visiting actress—every choice rewrites your love story. Meet someone, and fall in love that trembles in bones.

releases.name: GUTS
releases.summary: GUTS is a hilarious ultra-violent Tarantino-style over-the-top game where players must dismember each other. The fight continues even when there are just two little stumps, and it keeps going until one fighter emerges victorious after dismembering all the opponent's four limbs!

releases.name: Fallen City Brawl
releases.summary:
As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City's criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.

Inspired by arcade beat 'em ups of the late '80s and early '90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

releases.name: Gods With Guns
releases.summary: ? the MOST POPULAR bubble game play ? An exciting puzzle game? Connect with Facebook! Beat your friends with high score! HOW TO PLAY - Pop the same color adjecent bubbles. - Blocks of at least 3 pop. - 50 seconds to match as many bubbles as you can. - In fever mode, get double score. FEATURES: - Simple game rule - Connect with Facebook, challenge with your friends - Nice music - Charming retina HD graphics! - Fully universal support

releases.name: Agefield High: Rock the School
releases.summary: Play against others to test your skills to make the biggest word out of the given letters.How big a word can you make in 20 seconds?Play against friends and random players to race for glory!Take the worldwide challenge to find the 10 letter word as quick as you can!

releases.name: Used Cars Simulator
releases.summary: Used Cars Simulator - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

releases.name: Cargo Rail Tycoon
releases.summary: Cargo Rail Tycoon is a trading and train-driving game set on the railways of Michigan. You are a freight entrepreneur with one simple goal: turn a small convoy and a modest bankroll into a rail empire. Buy goods where they are cheap, load your wagons, and haul them across the map to the towns that need them most — profit is made on the journey, not on the spot.But this isn't a game you play from a spreadsheet. Every trip puts you in the cab. You drive the train yourself: open the throttle on the straights, ease off through the curves — brake too late and you derail — and read the signs at each switch to reach the right town. Bandits may block the tracks; stop and haggle the ransom down, or pay the price. Arrive fast for a bonus, but arrive at the right destination or lose out.Between journeys you negotiate face-to-face with each town's station master. Haggle their margin down before you trade — offer low, and watch them squirm — then choose your next destination wisely and roll out again. Twenty-six towns are waiting, and the farther north you push, the bigger the rewards for those willing to travel.Turn cargo into cash, cash into a bigger convoy, and a bigger convoy into a fortune — just don't go bankrupt on the way.Key features-Trade across 26 towns — a living supply-and-demand economy where prices rise and fall. Find the routes, corner the goods, grow your cash.-Drive every train — first-person rail journeys where speed, curves, braking and route choices are all yours. Go too fast and you derail; take the wrong turn and you arrive at the wrong town.-Haggle every deal — negotiate the station master's margin down with a multi-round back-and-forth. Push too hard and he'll dig in.-Bandit roadblocks — stop and negotiate the ransom, or plough through and pay for it.-Build your convoy — buy wagons matched to your cargo and expand your train as your business grows.-A fresh route every trip — procedurally generated railways with curves, bridges, rivers and scenery, and a destination that can lie straight ahead, left or right — follow the signs.-Explore the whole map — the far-north towns pay the best prices, rewarding the boldest hauls.

releases.name: EA Sports FC 27
releases.summary:
Step into The Grounds, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch. Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay, featuring dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more community-driven innovations. Sign your next star in Manager Career through a rebuilt Transfer Market with realistic player values and active club bidding. Master new negotiation tactics, including performance and buy-back clauses, as Dynamic OVRs reflect player form, morale, and fitness across every club. Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favourite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season.
Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 21,000+ licensed players. [EA Sports]

releases.name: Angle Of Attack
releases.summary:
Climb into your state-of-the-art fighter jet and brace yourself for intense 2D fights over sprawling fields, bustling cities, and treacherous seas. From intercepting warheads on the fly to smashing through huge air fortresses, every operation demands razor-sharp reflexes and shooting precision.

A rogue squadron known as the Clever Foxes Clan has launched a coordinated, full-scale assault. They've crushed recon units, breached coastal defenses, and now threaten total domination. With communications severed and ground forces scattered, your elite squadron is all that stands between them and victory.

Soar into battle, dodge relentless enemy fire, and complete critical objectives across dynamic battlefields. From strafing hardened ground targets to outmaneuvering deadly submarines and aircraft carriers, your skills will be tested at every turn. Victory is earned in the skies one mission at a time.

Do you have what it takes to win?


Features:
* Fast-paced 2D aerial combat
* Retro-inspired pixel art style
* 30 challenging missions
* 30+ enemy unit types across land, sea, and air
* 3 difficulty modes for all skill levels

releases.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
releases.summary: Tokyo has fallen. In the wake of the 'Collapse,' time is your ultimate weapon. Unleash real-time skills, predict enemy moves, and deliver devastating counters in this high-stakes Tactical Timeline RPG.

releases.name: Into the Radius 2
releases.summary: Into the Radius 2 is an immersive VR survival shooter, set in a realm of surreal landscapes and deadly entities known as Pechorsk Anomaly. Arm yourself with realistic weapons and venture deeper into the mysteries that lie within, either solo or as part of a team.

releases.name: PUPU's Adventure Park
releases.summary: Collect Extra Lives and PrizesJump Through Unique and Colorful Worlds Avoid Deadly Obstacles and FallsWicked Fun Aim n' Bounce actionAngry Enemies to Jump and AvoidSuper Smooth Fun Physics Based Endless GameplayGame Center supportEasy Tap Controlsand much more…

releases.name: The Trolley Solution
releases.summary: Help!! Your mission is to rescue adorable penguins that have fallen through the ice! They keep getting trapped inside an ice cavern with no way to escape. Use your awesome brain power to solve the word puzzles by throwing snowballs at the icicles attached to the cavern ceiling.    Pull the snowball letter back with your finger, aim it at the icicles, and release!  With each correct letter you’ll see the snowball hit the icicles causing them to fall and break through the ice below. (Yeah!) Solve the word and all the ice blocks will break!! Your penguin can now reach the water and swim out to safety. The fewer tries you take to complete the word, the more points you earn!! Each round you play helps rescue penguins - so keep playing to build up your score and be a total hero!  Visit the penguin village to see all the silly penguins you’ve rescued! Tap on them to see their individual personalities come to life, move them around and position them where you’d like to within the village. You can use the pinch and zoom motion to resize the penguins and make them larger or smaller. Don’t forget to stop by the rescue center igloo and check the message photo board to see which penguins you have rescued and what ones are still missing and need your help! Challenge yourself to beat your top score! And hurry - RESCUE THOSE PENGUINS!!! •Select from multiple categories or just choose “random” for an even more challenging game! •Records High Score at the end of your game •Amazing high-definition graphics•Rescue and collect all the penguins! The more you play the more chances you have to save all of them.•Classic word puzzle game in the style of “hangman” or “wheel of fortune.”•Visit the rescue center, located inside the igloo in the Penguin Village, to see a photo board of all the penguins that need your help!•Move, tap, organize, and watch your penguins animate inside the Penguin Village. Use the pinch/zoom motion to resize them!!•Word puzzles get progressively harder as you answer more and more correctly. Challenge yourself to see how many you can answer consecutively!

releases.name: Bibi & Tina - Ready, Set, Ride!
releases.summary: Battle for your Kingdom in this deadly dragon inspired game... collect gold, get the girl and CONQUER your ENEMIES.FEATURES: ? Ultimate Kingdom BATTLES!!? Awesome graphics and EPIC music ? Simple controls for maximum pleasure ? Hours of awesome gameplay ? Battle your friends with multiplayer!

releases.name: Ancient Farm
releases.summary: They call her the streak!  Streak through the town.  Race as other streakers.  Don't let the Cops catch you or you will get busted!Easy tap controlsEndless Streaking Fun!(No actual nudity - characters have doll anatomy)
